text_block_list.text: On a certain day off, Air Groove summoned me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have considerable nerve making me wait, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Sorry……was there always a field here?
Sorry……was there always a field here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unaware? This field also belongs to Tracen grounds. 
Occasional practical lessons are conducted here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then. You were summoned here to transport that.
Air Groove gestured toward a wagon laden with red, white, and yellow blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The yield exceeded expectations. 
Unfortunate as it is, I require your labor.
choice_data_list: You took care of them well, so a lot bloomed huh.
You took care of them well, so a lot bloomed huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Unnecessary remarks. 
Cease idle chatter and begin loading them.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, gorgeous~! 
Thank you again this year, Air Groove-senpai!
Once the cart reached the front of the dormitories, a long queue of Umamusume formed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Limit one per person! Do not disrupt the queue. 
State your preferred color when your turn arrives.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Attach a letter or deliver it in person if possible. 
Express your ongoing gratitude properly.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: My mother will be thrilled!
Watching Air Groove interact with her juniors, realization struck: "Ah, could this be—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Correct. I cultivate them specifically to bloom at this timing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Living in dormitories keeps them separated from family. 
Occasions like this provide an ideal pretext to communicate their appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you familiar with the language of yellow carnations?
choice_data_list: The different colors have different meanings
The different colors have different meanings

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Starting from square one, I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Red carnations signify "devotion to mother." A standard choice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Conversely, yellow symbolizes "jealousy." Typically avoided.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yet among Umamusume, certain individuals deliberately select yellow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For second-generation Umamusume born to racing mothers... 
their mother is quite literally their greatest rival.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In other words, presenting it declares a vow: "I will surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Distribution complete. Your assistance is acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The sole remaining stem is this yellow carnation.
Air Groove looked down at the flower remaining in the cart with a quiet smile—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will deliver this one to my mother.
Just then, another Umamusume came sprinting up in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, you are... What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
I was doing self-practice and lost track of time... 
Um... are they all gone already?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No. Fortune favors you. 
Precisely one remains.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Here. Take it.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: Ah! Thank you so much!
Accepting the flower from Air Groove, the young girl bowed repeatedly before heading off.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Completely out of stock.
Air Groove muttered so with her usual cool expression. Impossible to tell her thoughts from face alone.
Suddenly, got worried remembering injury she sustained protecting her junior.
choice_data_list: Are you putting yourself off again?
Are you putting yourself off again?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Good grief, you worry too much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What happened during dance training was indeed unsightly. But... I have been thinking since then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: About how I must conduct myself as the "Empress"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Pursuing ideals while neglecting yourself brings collapse. That aspect... I failed to grasp as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But it is different now.
choice_data_list: Meaning, you've learned to value yourself?
Meaning, you've learned to value yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed... Even without flowers, I do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even without definite proof, my resolve is unwavering. All that remains is telling Mother directly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. Nothing for you to fret over.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Calm and collected. That is how trainer of the "Empress" should behave.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Though, well... only because you were so meddlesome... that I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I mean it is because you noticed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mother once said the same. "One cannot be 'queen' alone."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sincere gaze directed at you becomes mirror, reflecting ideal form.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, basically... it is like that.
choice_data_list: I'll continue to watch you closely
I'll continue to watch you closely

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph, why make me repeat it? ...Fool.
Receiving stern yet gentle scolding, watched her figure against setting sun.
